sources.braking: simulation assumption: conservative 0.5 versus configured max_decel magnitude 2.5; validate before motion release
sources.reaction: simulation object velocity fit window 0.6s + scan budget 0.3s + adapter budget 0.1s; covers drive watchdog 0.5s
sources.payload: simulation case: empty grippers; additional carried shapes are explicit scenario inputs
sources.policy_thresholds: design proposal simulation starting values; not hardware measurements
sources.scan_health: simulation assumption: at least 90 percent of rays finite-valid or positive infinity
sources.motion_estimate: simulation association: five consistent frames over 0.4s; 0.6s fit window, 6cm residual bound based on 3cm voxel resolution
sources.occupancy_motion: Fixed scan cells retain acquisition covariance and remain occupied until fresh free-space coverage clears them; no object motion is inferred from spatial identity. Dynamic tracked-object forecasts retain age and velocity covariance.
sources.angular_motion: Existing P2 angular cap 1.5 rad/s; nav2_params_mppi.yaml smoother angular acceleration/deceleration magnitude 3.2 rad/s2. Braking is a simulation assumption, requiring hardware evidence.
sources.command_leases: Existing P2 constraint lease and upstream command expiry 0.3 s; separate from the chassis drive watchdog 0.5 s. Maximum wire lease remains 0.5 s.
sources.planning_budget: P3 simulation starting values: 2s request timeout and 5 per-goal attempts follow existing path guard bounds; 30s episode deadline is a simulation assumption, not hardware validation.
sources.path_risk: Simulation starting value: existing 0.2s path-check period, one missed cycle plus 0.1s transport allowance. Age consumes distance at the enforced profile speed bound; hardware timing remains to be validated.
sources.local_detour: P3 simulation corridor: forward rejoin 3m, lateral bound 1.2m; hardware validation reserved.
sources.planning_takeover: Simulation admission: stopped <= 2cm/s and 0.03rad/s, start drift <=4cm, no route replacement within 0.6m terminal zone; 0.5s execution context timeout. Hardware thresholds need independent evidence.
sources.narrow_angular_speed: P4 simulation initial angular cap; requires independent hardware validation
sources.narrow_centering: Simulation-only entrance correction: <=5cm/s, 1cm release, <=30cm lateral sweep; validate swept envelope and latency on hardware.
sources.scan_obstacle_padding: Additional padding outside the measured occupancy cell, separate from acquisition covariance and robot clearance. Simulation paired replay removes the previous hardcoded 4cm per side; hardware retains 4cm pending validation.
